svg.text: S01 / Phase A · Unselected spatial proposal · meters / Z-up / north +Y

g.text: Two inhabited shoulders around a dry
ravine: upper civic ground, middle crossing
0 m: shoreline detour around the ravine toe
4 m: market crossing through two district fronts
8 m: civic bridge and separate upper streets
Ravine is scenic / inaccessible; no jumping
Site A and B lie in different town shoulders
Bridges are routes with landings, not teleports
T / CT and A / B remain provisional anchors
Dark masses: complete buildings, no entry
Red dashes: proposed view, not a path
Does losing a bridge over-constrain a late rotation?
Is the low shoreline journey worth its commitment?
Can a bridge holder watch more than one front?
No AML or physical acceptance at S01.
Layouts remain open to independent proposals.
I01: Press passage / I02: Customs porch / I03: School arcade / I04: Taverna gateway / I05: Inn archway
Body kept from Galini: radius 0.30 m / standing 1.80 m / crouch 1.10 m / step 0.30 m / slope ≤42°.
Dimensions and shown views are design hypotheses. Boundary/landing precision, sightlines and traversal require later layout and compiled review.
